name: Conflict at Darkspear Islands
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands.

Go, show them the might of the horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
